title: Connection Manager
hostKeyChanged: The host key has changed. Connection blocked. Verify the fingerprint.
sshAuthDescription: Credentials are used for this connection only and are not saved in the interface configuration.
vaultProtectedKey: Use the SSH key protected by the vault in this connection profile.
keyboardInteractiveDescription: The server will request passwords, verification codes, or other responses during connection. Entries are used only for this SSH authentication and are not saved or used for auto-reconnect.
credentialSaveDescription: By default, credentials are used for this connection only. Before choosing to save them, configure the vault in Settings → Connections and Security. Credentials are encrypted only after host verification and successful login; they are never stored as plain text.
authResponsePrivacy: Passwords, verification codes, and other responses are sent only to this SSH connection. They are not saved or used for auto-reconnect.
firstHostKeyDescription: Confirm the server's public-key fingerprint on the first connection.
verifyTrustedChannel: Compare this fingerprint through a trusted channel. Trust it only after confirming that it belongs to the target server.
trustOnceAndPermanent: Trust once applies only to this SSH connection. Save permanently to store the public key in the protected local host-key records and verify it automatically on later connections.
identityChangedDescription: The server public key differs from the trusted local record. The connection was blocked.
trustedKeyUpdated: Trusted host key record updated. Reconnect manually.
trustedKeyUpdateFailed: Could not update trusted host record: {{error}}
identityBlockedDetail: Connection stopped before SSH login credentials were sent. Obtain the new public key from the server console or another independent trusted source. If uncertain, close this dialog and contact the administrator.
newPublicKey: OpenSSH host public key verified through an independent trusted channel
confirmCurrentFingerprint: Enter the independently verified current fingerprint again
fingerprintMismatch: This does not match the currently observed fingerprint.
independentVerificationConfirm: I checked the server public key and fingerprint above through an independent trusted channel and confirmed that they belong to this server.
rotationDescription: The client checks that the pasted public key matches the key observed on this connection and that the previous trusted record is unchanged. It will not reconnect automatically; start a new SSH connection after the update.
rotationUnavailable: Host-key details for this connection are missing. Secure rotation cannot continue.
credentialWarning: Could not update trusted host record: {{error}}
hostKeySelectionFailed: Could not confirm the host-key choice. Please retry the connection.

sshErrors.connectionFailed: The connection could not be established. Check the host, port, and network.
sshErrors.authFailed: Authentication failed. Check the username and credentials.
sshErrors.credentialMissing: No usable credential was provided. Enter a password or select a private key.
sshErrors.credentialStoreUnavailable: The secure credential store is unavailable. Unlock it or try again later.
sshErrors.hostKeyUnknown: The host key has not been verified. Verify its fingerprint before connecting.
sshErrors.hostKeyMismatch: The host fingerprint changed. The connection was blocked. Verify the server identity.
sshErrors.hostKeyRejected: The host key was rejected. No login credentials were sent.
sshErrors.connectionTimeout: The connection timed out. Check network access and the SSH port.
sshErrors.connectionRefused: The server refused the connection. Check the SSH service and port.
sshErrors.dnsResolutionFailed: The host name could not be resolved. Check the host name and DNS.
sshErrors.privateKeyInvalid: The private key could not be read or decrypted. Check its path and passphrase.
sshErrors.authPromptTimeout: The server authentication prompt timed out. Start the connection again.
sshErrors.serverClosed: The server closed the SSH connection. Reconnect to continue.
sshErrors.channelOpenFailed: Could not open an SSH channel. Reconnect and try again.
sshErrors.ptyRequestFailed: The server could not allocate a terminal. Check account permissions.
sshErrors.shellRequestFailed: The server could not start an interactive shell. Check account configuration.
sshErrors.sessionClosed: The SSH session is closed. Reconnect before sending input.
sshErrors.sessionNotFound: The SSH session is no longer available. Reconnect to continue.
sshErrors.inputTooLarge: The input exceeded the allowed size and was blocked.
sshErrors.internal: An internal SSH error occurred. Close and reopen the connection.
sshErrors.unknown: The connection could not be established. Check the host, port, and network.

manager.dialogDescription: Manage local connection profiles and trusted SSH host keys.
manager.searchProfiles: Search name, host, user, port, or environment
manager.emptyProfilesHint: Add a server profile, then double-click it or press Enter to connect. You can securely save its password locally.
manager.permanentTrustDescription: A permanently trusted host is accepted only when its public key exactly matches this record. Revoking trust will require fingerprint verification the next time you connect.
manager.trustStorageNotice: Only public host keys are stored; login credentials are not included.
manager.renameGroupDescription: Renaming does not affect server profiles in this group.
manager.createChildGroupDescription: This subgroup will be created under “{{parent}}”.
manager.createGroupDescription: Organize locally saved server connections by environment or purpose.
manager.localGroupDescription: This name is used only to organize profiles in the Connection Manager.
manager.credentialChangeTitle: Connection account or authentication method changed
manager.credentialChangeDescription: Saved credentials remain bound to the original account and authentication method. You can clear them now or keep them for later cleanup.
manager.deleteProfileDescription: Delete the local profile for {{name}} and its saved port-forward rules. Running forwards will stop. Shared host-key trust records are not affected.
manager.clearSavedCredentials: Also clear the saved password and private-key passphrase
manager.credentialsWillRemain: Saved credentials will remain in the encrypted local vault and can be cleared later.
manager.previewConfigDescription: Select static host entries to import as local connection profiles.
manager.configSafetyNotice: Parsed without changing the source file. ProxyCommand and Match exec are not run. ProxyJump is not configured. IdentityFile paths are saved without reading or copying key contents.
manager.noStaticHosts: No concrete static host entries can be imported. Wildcard Host and dynamic Match entries are shown as warnings only.
manager.duplicateProfileSkipped: A profile with this name already exists and will be skipped.
manager.dynamicFieldsUnsupported: This entry contains dynamic fields that cannot currently be processed statically.
manager.importReviewHint: Review and edit imported profiles in the Connection Manager.
manager.doubleClickConnect: Double-click or press Enter to connect
manager.confirmForgetCredentials: Clear the saved password and private-key passphrase for this profile?
manager.keepSavedPassword: Leave blank to keep the saved password
manager.enterPasswordHint: Enter a password to avoid typing it on each connection
manager.noManagedKeys: No local SSH keys are available. Unlock the vault under Settings → Connections & Security to generate or import one.
manager.vaultKeyNotice: The key is encrypted in the local vault. You can enter its passphrase once when connecting or securely remember it.
manager.keyboardInteractiveReconnect: Multiple-prompt authentication requires user input and cannot auto-reconnect.
manager.autoReconnectDescription: Reconnect after a disconnection, up to 5 attempts. Off by default; enable separately for production hosts. Authentication is not retried without a usable credential.
manager.noGroups: No groups yet. Create a group to organize profiles.
manager.moveGroupContentsFirst: Move servers and subgroups out first

errors.loadTrustedHosts: Could not load trusted host records.
errors.usernameRequired: Enter a server user name before securely saving the SSH password.
errors.clearOldCredentials: Could not clear the old credentials. The profile was not changed.
errors.saveProfile: Could not save the server profile.
errors.passwordNotSaved: The profile was saved, but the password could not be securely stored.
errors.forgetCredentials: Could not clear the saved credentials.
errors.deleteCredentialsFirst: Could not clear the saved credentials. The profile was not deleted.
errors.deleteProfile: Could not delete the server profile.
errors.favorite: Could not save the favorite status.
errors.revokeTrust: Could not revoke trust for this host.
errors.desktopOnlyImport: Importing SSH Config is available in the desktop app.
errors.previewConfig: Could not preview the SSH Config file.
errors.importConfig: Could not import the selected SSH Config entries.
errors.groupNotEmpty: This group still contains servers or subgroups. Move them first.
errors.moveProfile: Could not move the server profile.

messages.passwordSaved: SSH password securely saved in the local vault.
messages.trustRevoked: Permanent trust for {{host}} was revoked. The fingerprint will be checked again next time.
